subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should CodexBar ship this spend-first aggregation as a permanent top-level Settings pane, or integrate it into an existing shared overview surface?
rationale: Both placements are technically viable, while repository vision requires sign-off for new product surfaces; code review cannot determine the intended long-term navigation and maintenance contract.

options.title: Integrate shared overview
options.body: Preserve the aggregation model but present it through the established shared overview pattern to limit top-level navigation growth.

options.title: Keep dedicated pane
options.body: Approve Usage & Spend as a permanent Settings destination, subject to satisfactory live bundle proof.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the draft unmerged until a maintainer sponsors a permanent spend-dashboard surface.

recommendation.title: Integrate shared overview
recommendation.body: Preserve the aggregation model but present it through the established shared overview pattern to limit top-level navigation growth.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available decision owner for a permanent top-level product surface.
